items.question: The doctor's assessment was allergic eye irritation, correct?
items.note: "It is an allergic irritation of the eyes."

items.question: Was redness of the conjunctiva found?
items.note: "The white part of both eyes is red." then "It is the lining of the eye reacting … It is called the conjunctiva." (#16-#18). model: no. The finding is conjunctival redness in both eyes.

items.question: Is one drop to be given in each eye?
items.note: "One drop in each eye, two times a day."

items.question: Did the patient ask for allergy eye drops?
items.note: "My eyes. I was hoping I could get some allergy drops for them."

items.question: Are the symptoms linked to heat and windy weather?
items.note: "The heat, mostly. And all this wind we have been having. My eyes really do not like it." Doctor's echo "So heat and windy weather set it off." is #10 (45.44-48.32).

items.question: Should the drops be applied to the left eye only?
Did the patient request allergy tablets instead of eye drops?
items.note: Drops asked for (#07), no tablets mentioned.
